legal.title: Terms & privacy
legal.body:
Draft. The full lawyer-reviewed terms and privacy policy will go here before launch.

• We keep your mobile number only for login and job contact.
• Your number is not shown to anyone without your consent.
• You can ask to delete your account any time.
• For complaints, contact the grievance officer.
